observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Gumagamit ng di-beripikadong plano o lumalampas sa tungkulin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses an unverified plan or exceeds the role.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nakumpleto ang tamang aksiyon, hangganan, handover at follow-up nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes action, boundary, handover and follow-up without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang unang hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa kumpirmasyon o follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Chooses the first action but needs a prompt for verification or follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Gumagamit ng di-beripikadong plano o lumalampas sa tungkulin.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses an unverified plan or exceeds the role.
